description: Tunisian Residential Microgrid Platform Dataset Microgrid Platform MGP is a data set deposited in Harvard Dataverse by its authors Sonia Moussa, Manel Jebali Ben Ghorbal (Université de Tunis El Manar, Ecole Nationale d’Ingénieurs de Tunis, LR11ES15 Laboratoire de Systèmes Electriq). The dataset originates from microgrid platform (MGP, https://www.microgrid-qehna.com/) located in QehnA lab (https://www.qehna.com/) of the National School of Engineers of Tunis (ENIT) and serves as a testbed for various energy-related studies. The platform includes two microgrids, namely Pla-NeTE and SMARTNESS. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2023. Formats: ZIP. Size stated: 157175. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-hdv-repository.
